user.title: Connect Comelit Door Bridge
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the private CT120 P14 bridge. The bridge must already be live-promoted and firewall-limited to this Home Assistant host.

error.cannot_connect: Bridge is unavailable, disabled, or its production runner identity is not valid
error.invalid_config: Use the private CT120 IPv4 URL on port 18014 and a shared secret of at least 32 bytes

open_door.name: Open door
open_door.description: Perform one protected Door operation. A service response is mandatory. ACKED is protocol evidence only and never proves the physical door opened.

operation_id.name: Operation ID
operation_id.description: Fresh p13-hermes UUID4 for this one-shot request. Never reuse it as a retry after UNKNOWN_OUTCOME.
